text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp—it's the season for many

inexperienced racers to make leaps and
bounds in
their development.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
S-summer camp?! This is bad, Trainer.
Really bad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well... summer camp is, like, peak
awkward
situation time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Like going swimming together in your
bathing
suits, sharing a bottle of
ramune, wearing yukata
and watching
fireworks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And then, at the end, the two of them....
Gaaah!
However you put it, th-that's just
too much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, sorry. I let my fantasies... I
mean, my
imagination, run wild.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've just never experienced this kind of
thing
before. I've been focused on
nothing but sports
my whole life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I was imagining all the
different
possibilities... Aaahh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can't stop fidgeting with worry. It's
like she
has a mistaken impression of
what summer camp
is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What if I meet someone? What am I
supposed to
do?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Coach me, Trainer! I don't know how to
hold a
conversation that isn't about
lifting and gettin'
ripped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a tall hurdle, but this might be a
good
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic in spring was fierce. Now, I
want her
to enjoy a nice change of pace
during camp.
